title: Price unknown-state acquisition before downstream protection
status_authority: Actual supplied source passages and scoped internal audits; no new Capital science verification.
reported_status: The source reports a quantitative acquisition resource law for one arbitrary unknown UNENCODED input exposed from its start to actual inaccessible dephasing,with every noncommuting source operation charged. The integrated action bound s<=64*A(4e/lambda)^2 gives matched quadratic peak-strength and quartic zero-start-slew success/error powers. An explicit qubit-qutrit exchange attains those powers in the enlarged source-access class. A collective-register converse forces Bell fidelity to zero at fixed local control/noise ratio and nonvanishing success as register size grows;ordinary parallel SWAP matches the deterministic n/eps control scaling when exchange is available. This is not a zero-capacity theorem,an immutable-port attaining receiver,or a practical hardware result.

proof_availability.classification_scope: This is a source-reported theoretical acquisition law,not a new Capital proof audit,hardware advantage or zero-capacity theorem. Input must be arbitrary and unencoded at the stipulated start;prior encoding changes the task. Known-state preparation,fresh-copy distillation,protected subspaces and task-specific measurements are not ruled out. All noncommuting source access must be charged;unbounded instantaneous measurement/control is excluded by the premises. Bell-input success can be state-dependent. The qutrit attaining exchange needs additional source transition access that an immutable longitudinal measurement port does not supply. Fixed startup slew is not hard spectral bandwidth. Actual bare-source hidden Z noise is required: cavity photon loss with jump a cannot simply be relabeled Z. New qutrit construction has analytic proof but no claimed executed numerical validation;moderate-bandwidth companion points are numerical,not interval-certified or experimental. Local initialization,flags,calibration,storage,extra noise and success-scaled instrument errors remain separate costs. Source says independent checks occurred within its run,but separate reviewer artifacts are unprovided;prior accepted scopes remain. Original P1 ZIP/full file uncollected under their boundary. Priority and competitive microscopic device performance are unestablished.
